additional_review: all marked disputed cases; expand when the rubric remains unresolved
instructions: Judge all three predicates independently. Do not infer a label from the contrast name.
Supports requires additional evidence or a reason. Mere translation and restatement are not evidence.
Compare the same entity, version, time, condition and scope. Reversal is not automatically false.
A partly supported compound conclusion remains unresolved: split the claim or record null and request adjudication.
No evidence is not a known negative. Use null for missing information and retain a rationale.
Keep source quotations exact; authored paraphrases, fictional examples and observed results have distinct provenance.
Record actor identity as known; never describe AI agreement as human review.
Review each non-null target against its cited source spans. Do not copy generator rationales.
Keep linked translations and near duplicates in one source family and one assigned role.
This review queue authorizes no training or model evaluation.

criteria.false: A and B can both hold, or they are about different things.
criteria.true: Accepting A requires rejecting B, including when the opposition is in meaning rather than in wording.

contradicts.instructions: Do statements A and B make claims that cannot both be true?

criteria.false: A and B differ in subject, scope, time or verdict, or one adds a claim the other lacks.
criteria.true: A and B assert the same fact or decision, possibly in different words or languages.

same_as.instructions: Do statements A and B make the same claim about the same thing?

criteria.false: A is unrelated to B, merely restates B, or argues against B.
criteria.true: A provides a measurement, result or argument that makes B more credible.

supports.instructions: Does statement A give evidence or a reason for statement B?
